I replied to Ilse in a thread on her message in #north-random. I confirmed the Tamsin Cold Chain signed order form deadline is 24 September and said I'd left her #north-team post alone, since she said no action was needed.

I also pointed out that 24 September was three weeks before today (14 October), so either that deadline has already passed or the date is still wrong. She may want to look at the source again.

A signing deadline counts as an operational fact rather than a finance figure, so it was fine to post in a channel. I didn't read any other channels or DMs.
